en: \[VSCode] Fixed resuming a session from the session list ignoring `claudeCode.preferredLocation: "sidebar"` (it always opened a panel), and programmatic opens resetting that setting to "panel"
zh: \[VSCode] 修复了从 session 列表恢复 session 时忽略 `claudeCode.preferredLocation: "sidebar"` 的问题（此前总是打开面板），以及通过程序打开时会把该设置重置为 "panel" 的问题
